codeReview.summary: The feature successfully unifies generator output paths to a single canonical location at `packages/app/app/lib/sync/generated/`. The backend `sync:generate` script was updated to output to the correct path, the `sync:clean` script was updated accordingly, the schema index.ts import was fixed, and the `.gitignore` was updated to reference the correct path. The duplicate `lib/db/generated/` directory no longer exists. All 4 packages build successfully.

VAL-0-001.evidence: backend/package.json sync:generate script outputs to ../app/app/lib/sync/generated. Generator successfully outputs 6 files (applier.ts, hooks.ts, init.sql, schemas.ts, services.ts, types.ts) to the unified location.

VAL-0-007.evidence: Only `packages/app/app/lib/sync/generated/` exists. `packages/app/app/lib/db/generated/` does not exist (ls returns 'No such file or directory').

sharedStateObservations.observation: The sync-fix-worker skill file (SKILL.md) was not found at `.factory/skills/sync-fix-worker/SKILL.md`. The worker still completed the task successfully by using the AGENTS.md documentation and validation contract.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: ENOENT error when attempting to read /Users/leobar37/.factory/skills/sync-fix-worker/SKILL.md. Worker transcript shows successful completion using mission.md and AGENTS.md instead.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The drizzle-sync generator CLI still outputs a stale message 'Import from ~/lib/db/generated/' at the end of generation, even though it now outputs to the correct `lib/sync/generated/` path. This is confusing for developers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Generator output shows: '✨ Done! Import from ~/lib/db/generated/' despite files actually being created at `lib/sync/generated/`. See transcript from sync:generate command run.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The .factory/services.yaml already includes sync:generate and sync:validate commands, which correctly run the generator. No new services needed to be added.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: services.yaml contains: `sync:generate: cd packages/backend && bun run sync:generate` and `sync:validate: cd packages/backend && bun run sync:validate`
